<!-- Static-capture / reduced-motion guard: ?still freezes all animation.
     Must run BEFORE particles.js so the constellation never starts its rAF loop. -->
<script>
  window.__STILL__ = location.search.indexOf('still') >= 0;
  if (window.__STILL__) {
    window.requestAnimationFrame = function(){ return 0; };
    window.setInterval = function(){ return 0; };
    document.documentElement.classList.add('still');
  }
</script>

<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/r134/three.min.js"></script>

<!-- Scroll-reactive multi-hue scene atmospheres -->
<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function(){
  var scenes = [
    ['rgba(167,139,250,.28)','rgba(95,184,173,.18)'],   // 0 hero     — indigo + teal
    ['rgba(95,184,173,.26)','rgba(198,161,91,.16)'],    // 1 about    — teal + citrus
    ['rgba(95,184,173,.24)','rgba(224,138,106,.20)'],   // 2 tools    — teal + coral
    ['rgba(224,138,106,.28)','rgba(167,139,250,.16)'],  // 3 projects — coral + indigo
    ['rgba(198,161,91,.26)','rgba(124,156,255,.18)'],   // 4 lit      — citrus + indigo
    ['rgba(124,156,255,.26)','rgba(95,184,173,.16)']    // 5 notes    — indigo + teal
  ];
  var bg = document.createElement('div'); bg.id = 'scene-bg';
  scenes.forEach(function(s, i){
    var l = document.createElement('div'); l.className = 'scene-layer';
    l.style.backgroundImage =
      'radial-gradient(54% 48% at 22% 20%, ' + s[0] + ', transparent 60%),' +
      'radial-gradient(52% 48% at 82% 34%, ' + s[1] + ', transparent 62%)';
    if (i === 0) l.style.opacity = '1';
    bg.appendChild(l);
  });
  document.body.prepend(bg);
  var layers = [].slice.call(bg.children);
  var sections = [].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('[data-scene]'));
  var current = -1;
  function pick(){
    var line = window.innerHeight * 0.42;
    var best = 0;
    sections.forEach(function(s){
      var idx = +s.getAttribute('data-scene');
      if (s.getBoundingClientRect().top <= line && idx > best) best = idx;
    });
    if (best !== current){
      current = best;
      layers.forEach(function(l, i){ l.style.opacity = (i === best) ? '1' : '0'; });
    }
  }
  window.addEventListener('scroll', pick, { passive: true });
  window.addEventListener('resize', pick);
  pick();
});
</script>
